t_android_c.html:
Install on Android

Android phone

  1. Open Chrome and go to genestjanramirez.com/fetch
  2. Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right
  3. Tap Install app (or Add to Home screen), then Install
  4. Or download the APK from the link in the description and allow Install unknown apps

t_ios_c.html:
Install on iPhone

iPhone and iPad

  1. Open Safari (not Chrome) and go to genestjanramirez.com/fetch
  2. Tap the Share button, the square with an arrow
  3. Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen
  4. Tap Add. The Fetch GenSan icon appears on your home screen

t_android_d.html:
Install on Android

Driver app on Android

  1. Open Chrome and go to genestjanramirez.com/fetch/driver
  2. Tap ⋮, then Install app
  3. Or install the Driver APK from the link in the description
  4. Allow Location when asked. Customers need to see you on the map

t_ios_d.html:
Install on iPhone

Driver app on iPhone

  1. Open Safari and go to genestjanramirez.com/fetch/driver
  2. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add
  3. Open the app from your home screen
  4. Allow Location and Camera when asked

Meet Fetch GenSan

The local app for rides, pabili, pick-up and delivery. Made in GenSan, for GenSan and all of Mindanao.

m_f1.html:
01 · Book in seconds

Ride, Pabili
or Delivery

Pick a service, type where you're going, done. Your pick-up comes from your GPS.

m_f2.html:
02 · You choose

Pick your driver

See the real vehicle, plate number, rating and price before you book. Motorcycle, tricycle, car or van.

m_f3.html:
03 · Fair prices

Meter or
fixed offer

Pay by actual km and minutes, or agree a price in chat. Drivers set their own rates.

m_f4.html:
04 · Safe

Everyone is verified

Real names, mobile numbers and valid IDs for drivers and customers. Live tracking, trip sharing and SOS.

m_f5.html:
05 · Stay in touch

Free chat.
One-tap call.

Message your driver inside the app and watch them come to you on the map.

m_f6.html:

Cash, GCash
or bank

Tip your driver, rate the trip, and earn suki points for up to 10% off.

m_f7.html:
07 · Hands-free

Just ask George

Your voice assistant. Book a ride, check where your driver is, message them, or play music.

m_f8.html:
08 · For drivers

Your rates.
Your schedule.

Go online when you want. Accept or counter offers. Get paid directly to your GCash.
